The '''2019 Netherlands National Championship''' (Netherlands Nationals) was held on 29 December 2019 in Nijmegen, at the home of tournament director [[Tom Damen]]. Eleven players played six Swiss games. Martin and [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] finished the Swiss at 5–1, and Cedrik won the final confrontation.<ref name="nln">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=73671 Netherlands Nationals Nijmegen - December 29th], forum.starwarsccg.org (5 October 2019 – 12 January 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105004406/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t73671.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]] (all Virtual cards)<ref name="nln" />
* '''Site:''' Nijmegen, Netherlands<ref name="nln" />
* '''Date:''' 29 December 2019<ref name="nln" />
* '''Structure:''' 6 games Swiss (SoS), final confrontation if the top two have equal records<ref name="nln" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Tom Damen]]<ref name="nln" />
* '''Field:''' 11 players<ref name="nln" />
